title: After printing 40,000 whistles, this is the 3D printer I’d buy

claims.claim: Bambu P2S Combo 3D yazıcı, 1 Aralık'a kadar 649 dolardan satışta olup normal fiyatı 749 dolardır.

evidence.quote: It’s on sale for $649 through December 1st, but I’d vouch for it even at its normal $749 price.

claims.claim: Yazar, P2S dahil dört farklı yazıcıda toplam 6.770 saat baskı süresi ve 40.000 düdük basımı gerçekleştirmiştir.

evidence.quote: After printing 40,000 whistles, this is the 3D printer I’d buy
After racking up 6,770 hours of print time across four different printers, I’m sure of my recommendation.

I’ve spent an entire year testing the P2S alongside several competitors, printing 40,000 whistles for ICE whistleblowers along the way. After racking up 6,770 hours of print time across four different printers, I’m sure of my recommendation.

claims.claim: Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 Combo 3D yazıcının fiyatı 369 dolardır ve Bambu P1S Combo ise 509 dolardır.

evidence.quote: Others will say you shouldn’t spend so much when a $369 Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 Combo or a $509 Bambu P1S Combo can print just as well.

claims.claim: Yazar Centauri Carbon ile 1.271 saat, Centauri Carbon 2 ile 939 saat baskı yapmıştır.

evidence.quote: I’ve spent 1,271 hours printing with the Centauri Carbon, and 939 hours with a Centauri Carbon 2

claims.claim: Bambu P2S modelinde 1.692 saatlik baskı süresinde nozul iki kez değiştirilmiştir.

evidence.quote: In 1,692 hours of printing with the P2S, I’ve had to swap out the nozzle twice
Anecdotally, my Bambu printers have led a comparatively charmed life: In 1,692 hours of printing with the P2S, I’ve had to swap out the nozzle twice

claims.claim: Elegoo yazıcılarda sekiz adet nozul 25 dolara, tüm sıcak uç (hotend) ise 30 dolara mal olmaktadır.

evidence.quote: either by wrenching off a hot nozzle so you can clean or inexpensively replace it ($25 for eight nozzles) or by fishing out tiny wires and unscrewing two bolts to remove an entire $30 hotend

When you jam today’s Elegoo printers, you’re going old-school, either by wrenching off a hot nozzle so you can clean or inexpensively replace it ($25 for eight nozzles) or by fishing out tiny wires and unscrewing two bolts to remove an entire $30 hotend

claims.claim: Bambu P2S modelinin aletsiz değiştirilebilen sıcak ucunun (hotend) fiyatı 18 dolardır.

evidence.quote: With Bambu’s P2S, you can just yank off a gasket and open one spring clip to swap a whole new toolless hotend ($18) in less than a minute.

claims.claim: Yazarın P1P modeliyle yaptığı 3D baskı süresi yaklaşık 3.000 saattir.

evidence.quote: I upgraded my P1P with most of the P1S upgrades, and it’s been a reliable workhorse: nearly 3,000 hours of 3D printing so far.
